verdict.rationale: Cactus has public GitHub repositories (cactus-compute/cactus, cactus-compute/needle) and describes its local fine-tuning package as open source, so outside contribution is plausible. However, nothing in the evidence describes how contributions are accepted or how contributors are recognized. Missing for 10: contribution guidelines (CONTRIBUTING file), a PR/review process, a license statement, a collaborator or maintainer recognition path, and community or hands-on evidence of external contributors being accepted.
